text: The Committee shall consist of the following five (5) members: (a) the CEO; (b) the CFO; (c) the General Counsel; (d) one independent director; and (e) one Investor designee.

Termination requires the following three (3) conditions: (a) written notice of the breach; (b) a thirty (30) day cure period; (c) failure to cure within that period; and (d) delivery of a termination certificate.

The Purchaser must satisfy the following four (4) closing conditions: (a) delivery of the deed; and (b) payment of the balance.

Section 9. Notices. Any notice shall be in writing.
The Agent shall perform the following three duties: (a) collect payments; (b) maintain records; (c) remit taxes; and (d) issue receipts.
The Purchaser shall satisfy both of the following conditions: (a) delivery of the officer certificate; (b) payment of the fee; and (c) release of all liens.

The Employer observes the following dozen holidays: (1) New Year's Day; (2) Memorial Day; (3) Independence Day; (4) Labor Day; (5) Thanksgiving Day; (6) Christmas Day; (7) Martin Luther King Day; (8) Presidents' Day; (9) Juneteenth; (10) Columbus Day; (11) Veterans Day; and (12) New Year's Eve.
The Consultant shall provide services including the following three (3) deliverables: (a) a market study; and (b) a financial model.
The Borrower shall, inter alia, observe the following four (4) covenants: (a) maintain insurance; and (b) deliver quarterly reports.
The following two (2) covenants apply: (a) the Borrower shall: (i) maintain insurance; and (ii) deliver quarterly reports; and (b) the Borrower shall not incur additional debt.
Acceleration requires the following two (2) events: (a) a payment default; (b) an insolvency event; and (c) a change of control.
